symptom: Kissat 4.0.2 aborts on certain CNF inputs with 'assertion !DISCONNECTED (res) failed' in last_enqueued_unassigned_variable (decide.c:17). Caused by the VMTF queue not re-establishing stamping order after factoring/BVA introduces new variables; fixed in release 4.0.3.

interesting.output_contains: Assertion failed: (!DISCONNECTED (res)), function last_enqueued_unassigned_variable, file decide.c, line 17.
